Whether it’s tornadoes, flooding, or severe storms, having a plan for your family, emergency supplies ready, and staying up to date on weather alerts can make all the difference.

Thank you @VP Vance and @POTUS for leading this charge to crack down on fraud and work to restore transparency and accountability to federal programs.

As we reflect this Memorial Day, please join me in honoring the three Alabamians, Major Alex Klinner, Major Ariana G. Savino, and Technical Sargent Ashley B. Pruitt, who lost their lives this March.

I’m deeply committed to improving soldiers’ quality of life, and I’m excited the project is nearing completion.

This Memorial Day, we remember and honor the courageous men and women who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country.

Their service secured the freedoms we cherish, and their legacy will never be forgotten. May we live each day worthy of their service and sacrifice.

Thankful for the brave law enforcement officers who responded quickly to the shooting at the White House. 

Wesley and I are praying for the safety of @POTUS and everyone at the White House tonight as we await for more information.


Secretary Markwayne Mullin (@SecMullinDHS)

I am closely monitoring the shooting incident near the White House and will update the public as we have more information. 

Tonight’s shooting is a reminder of the dangers our law enforcement officers face every day.

Thrilled to see Kevin Warsh officially sworn in as Fed chair. He is the right man for the job at the right time in our nation’s history.

I look forward to seeing how his leadership restores confidence at the Fed.


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

Kevin Warsh has been officially sworn in as Chairman of the Federal Reserve by Justice Clarence Thomas at the White House. 🇺🇸

Wesley and I are incredibly sad to learn the diagnosis of Director Gabbard’s husband Abe, and are praying for her family during this time.

Grateful for @DNIGabbard’s tireless service in keeping our nation safe.
Grateful to our May interns for their hard work, energy, and dedication. We’re grateful for all you contributed to Team Britt!

The Senate Page Program is a special tradition, and it’s always a privilege to spend time with these bright young leaders. Grateful to join @SenBooker in thanking them for their hard work and service in the Senate.

Wesley and I are devastated to hear this news. His wife Samantha, two children, and loved ones are in our prayers tonight. Kyle will be missed.


NASCAR (@NASCAR)

We are saddened and heartbroken to share the news of the passing of Kyle Busch, a two-time Cup champion and one of our sport's greatest and fiercest drivers. He was 41 years old.

We extend our deepest condolences to the Busch family, Richard Childress Racing and the entire motorsports community.

What an exciting week in Congress!

I introduced the GAME Act, helped lead TREY’s Law to unanimous Senate passage, and Lulu’s Law is headed to @POTUS’s desk after passing the House.

Alabamians didn’t elect me to just talk about problems, they sent me here to find solutions and that’s exactly what I’ll continue to deliver.

Video

The Tennessee-Tombigbee Waterway is critical to Alabama and our nation’s inland navigation network.

Proud to keep fighting for the resources and infrastructure investments needed to strengthen commerce and support jobs across our great state.

Endometriosis affects many women across our country and is one of the most common underlying causes for infertility. We have to take this disease seriously from the start, so women aren’t waiting years for answers about their health.

Read my latest op-ed in @TheHill, where I discuss why Congress needs to step up and do more. thehill.com/opinion/healthca…
